problems.p1title: Your brand deserves more than a generic video
problems.p1desc: We create visual narratives that communicate who you truly are, not just what you do.

problems.p2desc: From corporate spots to high-impact campaigns. Real flexibility without compromising quality.
problems.p3desc: Agile management from pre-production to final delivery. We know your time is money.

services.heading: Audiovisual Services
services.sub: We cover the full production cycle — from concept to distribution.
services.s1desc: Institutional videos, brand presentations, content for social networks and digital platforms.
services.s2desc: Short films and fiction projects aimed at national and international festivals.
services.s3desc: Corporate, product, event, and portrait photography. Images that communicate before a single word is read.
services.s4desc: Video editing, color grading, motion graphics, sound mixing, and VFX.
services.s5desc: Camera operation and technical production for live sports, cultural, and corporate events.
services.s6desc: Spain–Colombia and India connections. Global reach projects leveraging active co-production agreements.

about.heading: Art without expressive barriers
about.lead: Masala Studios was born with a utopian vision: to create art without creative or geographic limits. The name says it all — masala, in Hindi, means 'a mixture of spices'.
about.body: We believe that beyond impacting those who see a work today, it is possible to create a faithful portrait of reality that can be recovered and studied in the future, like an archaeological find.
about.m2text: Incubated at GO2Work — School of Industrial Organization, Málaga
about.m4text: 6 international awards in India, UK, France & USA
